# Download

Pick a channel. **Stable** is the recommended build; **Beta** gets new features first and may
have rough edges. Older builds are on the [releases page](https://github.com/sigmabeta/chipbox/releases).

=== "Stable — 3.0.0"

    Release **[3.0.0](https://github.com/sigmabeta/chipbox/releases/tag/3.0.0)** — changelog and every asset on its release page.

=== "Beta — 3.0.1-alpha"
